name: SMS commands
summary: Replies people text to the platform's SMS number (HELP, STOP, START, and queries).

roles.note: An incoming phone number is matched to a user. There is no project role involved.

nfr.statement: Time to reply to an incoming SMS command.
nfr.open_question: Is there a carrier or compliance requirement on reply time for STOP and HELP?

requirements.title: HELP, STOP and START are handled separately
requirements.statement: Incoming texts are trimmed and lower-cased. HELP returns help text. STOP deletes the phone's session and replies with an unsubscribe message. START replies that the number is subscribed. Anything else is matched to a user by phone number and handled as a query.
open_checks: A START reply doesn't prove a lasting subscription was created; phone normalisation, shared numbers and Twilio request authentication need checks

acceptance_criteria.then: Their SMS session is deleted, and they get the unsubscribe reply
